page: Microsoft Azure E112ibds_v5 is an isolated, memory-oriented virtual machine instance running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 112 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 56 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8370C processor operating at a base frequency of 2.8 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, the instance is equipped with 672.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 6.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Local storage is bundled, consisting of a 3891 GB SSD, and the instance is fully capable of utilizing Premium Storage configurations.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core and memory subsystem performance. The instance achieved a multi-core stress-ng score of 108,527.62 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 17,911.0, both falling into the strong tier. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with cached small-block reads reaching 5,839.59 GB/sec and uncached large-block reads at 337.25 GB/sec. Cryptographic capabilities are notable, with the Passmark CPU encryption test reaching a top-tier score of 98,760.0, aided by hardware-accelerated AES and VAES instructions.

While multi-threaded execution and memory throughput are strong, single-core performance remains average, as evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 1,701.0. Additionally, without dedicated hardware accelerators, the instance is poorly suited for large-scale AI tasks, with 70B LLM text generation dropping to 2.52 tokens/sec. However, the combination of high memory capacity, fast local SSD storage, and strong database operation benchmarks makes this instance highly cost-efficient for memory-intensive enterprise applications, large relational databases, Redis caching layers, and high-throughput web serving.
description: The Microsoft Azure E112ibds_v5 is an isolated virtual machine instance designed for memory-intensive workloads and high-performance block storage. Powered by a 2.8 GHz Intel Xeon 8370C processor with 112 dedicated vCPUs (56 physical cores) and 672.0 GB of RAM, it delivers a high resource density of 6.0 GB of memory per core. The instance includes a 3,891 GB local SSD and supports Premium Storage. Benchmarks reveal strong multi-core processing, exceptional memory bandwidth, and top-tier cryptographic performance, though single-core execution is average. Lacking GPU acceleration, it is not suited for heavy LLM generation but excels in database operations, Redis caching, and enterprise application hosting.
